references.label: Market Intelligence
references.extraction: Market browsing should combine category navigation, watchlist/tape scanning, axis-bearing charts, selected-market detail, liquidity/spread context, proof state, and insufficient-data states.

references.label: Media Operations
references.extraction: Content operations should separate command triage, approval queues, publishable channels, QA evidence, Discord handoff, posting status, and time-series output health.

references.label: Business Operations
references.extraction: Business cockpits should show executive rollups, accountability, work queues, decision logs, objective progress, and evidence behind readiness.

references.label: Planning And Calendar
references.extraction: Planning views should use a real calendar/work surface, selected-day or range drawers, library-to-plan flows, manual override, and clear generated-versus-human state.

references.label: Cost And Performance
references.extraction: Cost dashboards should pair spend timelines with provider attribution, business-unit impact, efficiency ratios, anomaly states, freshness, and drilldowns.

references.label: Proof And Governance
references.extraction: Governance surfaces should make ownership, proof, blockers, exceptions, adoption status, and next action visible without dumping raw audit text.

reviewRegistry.purpose: Persistent review state for Hermes Dashboard Kit component families. This file is the auditable bridge between Mobbin/reference intake, human taste review, and project adoption.

approvalRules: Every approved family must have desktop and mobile light-mode screenshots.

Primary charts must prove visible axes, labels, legends, units, and nonblank plotted regions.
Tables must prove one card wrapper, one header, one toolbar, and one pagination footer.
Shell captures must prove there is one shell and the content pane owns scrolling.
